name: Arrow callout
description: Curved arrow that draws in towards a point with a label at its tail. The tip follows the item position, so keyframes track a moving object.
whenToUse: Point at something on screen: a part, a button, a detail. Use keyframes when the target moves.

label.description: Text at the tail; empty hides it

angle.description: Direction the arrow comes from, degrees (0 = from the right, 90 = from below, 180 = from the left, 270 = from above)

targetX.description: Tip offset from centre, fraction of width

targetY.description: Tip offset from centre, fraction of height
